reusable_pieces.name: Scheduler orchestration and job registry
reusable_pieces.description: Maintains a job list, dispatches due jobs in sorted order without replaying missed runs, runs a snapshot of all jobs, filters and removes jobs by tag, and reports the next run or idle duration.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: The supplied Scheduler definition includes get_jobs, clear, cancel_job, every, _run_job and timing properties. Empty registries or empty tag matches return None for next-run queries. _run_job removes jobs returning the CancelJob class or an instance; cancel_job catches ValueError. run_all sleeps after each job, including the last. Observed Job.should_run asserts next_run exists. Job.run can return CancelJob before execution, otherwise calls the callback, updates last_run, reschedules and checks the deadline again. Callback exceptions are not caught here. Job construction, logger initialization and relevant import statements are excerpted, but Job._schedule_next_run is not supplied.

reusable_pieces.name: intword large-number text formatting
reusable_pieces.description: Converts numeric input to magnitude labels from thousand through decillion and googol, with configurable formatting, negative signs, rounding carry to the next magnitude, and localization hooks.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: Observed support includes powers, human_powers, _format_not_finite, bisect, postponed annotations, and imports of _ngettext, decimal_separator and NS_. Preserve magnitude-table alignment and the rounded-value carry comparison. The function checks finiteness before integer conversion, returns special strings for nonfinite values, returns str(value) on TypeError or ValueError during conversion, and returns integer text below 1000. Larger values use floating-point division, percent formatting, plural selection and decimal substitution. Only conversion is inside the exception handler; formatting and localization errors propagate. human_powers initialization calls NS_, whose implementation is absent. Resolve localization behavior and NumberOrString before integration. The supplied notice requires retaining its copyright and permission text in copies or substantial portions.
